Systems Software QA Engineer

  

This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

   

As a Systems Software QA Engineer, you will take part in the design, development, and integration of the testing of complex software solutions that impact HPE’s products and services. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, mentor junior staff, and drive technological innovation to ensure high-quality, scalable software systems.

Key Responsibilities:

Engage with multiple project teams in all phases of functional and integration testing.
Manage relationships with internal and external development partners.
Review and evaluate designs for compliance with standards, providing feedback to improve quality.
Offer expertise in software architecture and contribute to cross-organizational projects.
Drive the adoption of new technologies and innovative solutions.
Mentor and guide less experienced team members.

Requirements:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
Typically, 4+ years of experience in software development and testing.
Strong proficiency in Python and automation frameworks.
Knowledge of Kubernetes and storage concepts.
Proven experience in designing robust test plans and complex test cases.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
Effective communication skills in English and local languages.

Knowledge and Skills:

Extensive experience with multiple software systems design tools and programming languages.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Deep understanding of software architecture for products and solutions.
Experience designing and integrating software systems across multiple platforms.
Knowledge of software testing methodologies, including writing and executing test plans, debugging, and scripting.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts to senior management.
